title: Sunday · the polo on the hanger
logline: The Motel Application's Sunday: a maroon polo on a wire hanger in three tiers — on the garage door's hook, on the Datsun's passenger seat, on the motel's office door's hook — and never on a man. The uniform arrives before the job.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a maroon polo on a wire hanger on the garage door's hook.

image.prompt: a maroon polo shirt on a wire hanger hung from a garage door's hook, watercolor

panels.name: Hook

panels.composition: Tier 2: the same polo on its hanger laid on a pickup's passenger seat, the road in the window.

image.prompt: a maroon polo shirt on a hanger laid across a pickup's passenger seat with a coastal road in the window, watercolor

panels.name: Seat

panels.composition: Tier 3: the polo on the hook inside a motel office's door, the desk beyond, the bell, nobody.

image.prompt: a maroon polo shirt on a hanger hung inside a motel office door with a desk and a bell beyond, nobody, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Office
